Bonnier|2026-07-10|Loglisci, Lindsay|Abacherli, Joel; Westenskow, Lexi|RE: QK63283 00105 - Bonnier - Hours question|QK63283 00105 - Bonnier - Hours question|Y|image002.jpg; image003.png|1|Hi, ~ ~ The prior plan excluded part-time employees from plan participation, with the exception that any part-time employee who completed a Year of Service (1,000 hours during the employment year) would become eligible to participate. We mirrored that prior plan provision. ~ ~ With respect to the long-term part-time (LTPT) rules, those are separate from the plan’s standard eligibility provisions. Even though part-time employees are excluded as a class, SECURE 2.0 requires certain long-term part-time employees to be permitted to make elective deferrals once they satisfy the applicable LTPT service requirements (assuming they are not otherwise excluded under a permissible exclusion). The LTPT rules operate as an exception to the otherwise applicable part-time exclusion. ~ ~ Regarding your questions on hours administration, because eligibility under both the Year of Service provision and the LTPT rules is based on hours of service, the preferred method is actual hours. If the employer does not currently track actual hours, they would need to determine an acceptable hours equivalency method if permitted for their payroll administration and ensure it is applied consistently. There is not a default semi-monthly equivalency value that Transamerica assigns. ~ ~ Since the client has confirmed they do not currently have any part-time employees, it may also be worth confirming whether they would prefer to remove the part-time exclusion altogether if excluding the class does not have any practical impact on their workforce. Removing the exclusion would simplify future administration and avoid the need to administer both the Year of Service exception and the LTPT rules should part-time employees be hired in the future. ~ ~ Thanks ~ ~ Lindsay Loglisci ~ ~ Plan Specialist, Document Operations ~ ~ lindsay.loglisci@transamerica.com <mailto:lindsay.loglisci@transamerica.com> ~ ~ Transamerica ~ ~ transamerica.com <https://www.transamerica.com/> ~ ~ Facebook <https://www.facebook.com/Transamerica> / X <https://www.x.com/transamerica> / YouTube <https://www.youtube.com/transamerica> / LinkedIn <https://www.linkedin.com/company/transamerica> ~
